summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 8, 2026. Proposals 4 through 7, comprising reverse share split authorization, share capital increase, private placement exercises, and auditor reappointment, were approved. Proposals 1 through 3, covering director class redesignation, compensation policy extension, and board committee compensation, failed. This is a routine disclosure of an ordinary shareholder meeting outcome with no special-situation transaction, strategic action, or abrupt management change. The filing simply confirms shareholder votes on standard corporate governance and capital matters, with no deal terms, pricing, or transactional elements to analyze.
